explication: Whisper is a speech-recognition library and CLI. The principal workflow is: an application supplies an audio file, audio is decoded and converted into log-Mel features, sliding-window transcription orchestrates language/task selection and decoding, the Transformer produces tokens, and timing logic returns timestamped text. Model loading optionally retrieves verified weights. The excerpts directly support the core inference path; some CLI output and lower-level orchestration details were not sampled.
